page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.2xlarge is an x86_64 compute-optimized server instance built on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features an AMD EPYC 7H12 processor operating at 2.6 GHz, configured with 4 physical cores and 8 hyperthreaded virtual CPUs with dedicated allocation. It includes 16.0 GB of RAM, offering a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The system includes 32 KB L1d cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 16 MB L3 cache, alongside hardware support for AES, SHA_NI, BMI2, ADX, FMA, and base AVX instructions, though AVX-512 extensions are unsupported. The instance includes no local storage and relies on network-attached storage, supported by a 2 Gbps baseline network bandwidth.

In benchmark evaluations, the ecs.c6a.2xlarge demonstrates moderate overall compute performance with specific bandwidth limitations. Standard CPU benchmarks, such as Geekbench single-core 1315.0 and multi-core 5025.0 scores, place the instance in the average category across general compute tasks, software compilation with Clang 7237.0, and Passmark database operations 2659.95. However, stress-ng multi-core tests yield a weak output of 3073.97, and Passmark physics processing registers in the lower performance tier. Memory subsystem performance shows strong cached throughput of 395.92 GB/sec, but drops during uncached large-block read 32.16 GB/sec and write 16.75 GB/sec transfers.

The compute-oriented design provides resource density tailored for workloads that require modest RAM relative to dedicated CPU resources without demanding sustained uncached memory bandwidth. Given its balance of dedicated core allocation, average static web serving throughput of 6.78 GB/sec, and solid Redis SET performance of 7.44 million operations per second, the ecs.c6a.2xlarge serves as a cost-effective choice for light application servers, web serving, microservices, and general software build environments where local NVMe disks and specialized AVX-512 instructions are not required.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c6a.2xlarge is a compute-optimized instance equipped with 8 dedicated vCPUs based on the 2.6 GHz AMD EPYC 7H12 processor and 16.0 GB of system RAM. Built on KVM virtualization, it provides basic AVX, AES, and SHA_NI instruction support while omitting AVX-512. The instance features no local disk storage and operates on a 2 Gbps baseline network connection. Benchmark profiles reveal steady average performance across standard single-core and multi-core tasks, including Geekbench software compilation, Passmark database execution, and Redis SET throughput reaching 7.44 million operations per second. However, heavy uncached memory bandwidth and stress-ng multi-core synthetic loads show lower throughput profiles. Designed for balanced processing efficiency without local storage overhead, the ecs.c6a.2xlarge fits web serving, lightweight microservices, and general CI/CD build environments.
